# SSAC27 full paper — Amendment 1 decision analyses (E10, E11, E12, E17): RESULTS

**Generated by `scripts/report_sloan_fullpaper_amend1_decisions.py` from the outputs of `scripts/sloan_fullpaper_amend1_decisions.py`, committed under `docs/research/artifacts/sloan-fullpaper-amend1-decisions-2026-11/`. Every number below is read from those files.** Pre-registration: `docs/research/sloan-full-paper-preregistration-2026-11-03.md` (commit `f52e7c831`) and `docs/research/sloan-full-paper-preregistration-amendment-1-2026-11-04.md` (Amendment 1, commit `f1a3453da`), sections E10, E11, E12 and E17.

**EXPLORATORY.** Destination seasons 2020–2025 were already inspected for the submitted abstract, so nothing here is a confirmatory test. P1 and P1-late (2026-27) stay the confirmatory tests, and this generator reads no 2026-27 data.

## In plain words

* **Cross-league ordering (E10, primary).** When two candidates come from different leagues, the league-aware forecast puts the better player first in 73.7% of pairs, against 72.4% for history alone: a gain of 1.32 percentage points (95% CI [0.39, 2.28]). Inside one league the gain is 0.04 points (95% CI [-0.77, 0.89]). So league adjustment helps where it should, between leagues, but the gain is small: about 1 pair in 76.
  * Licensed sentence: "Between candidates from different leagues, the league-aware forecast orders 73.7% of pairs correctly against 72.4% for history alone."
* **Who gets mis-rated (E11).** A league-blind (history-only) forecast is clearly off for 2 of 10 source leagues after Holm adjustment: Italy (LBA), Spain (ACB). In each case it **underrates** the players (forecast below what they then did).
  * Italy (LBA): history-only signed error -1.48 EFF/36 (95% CI [-2.15, -0.81], Holm p 0.010); league-aware -1.13 ([-1.86, -0.45]). Licensed: "A league-blind forecast underrates arrivals from Italy (LBA) by 1.48 EFF/36."
  * Spain (ACB): history-only signed error -1.30 EFF/36 (95% CI [-2.10, -0.52], Holm p 0.010); league-aware -0.64 ([-1.38, 0.06]). Licensed: "A league-blind forecast underrates arrivals from Spain (ACB) by 1.30 EFF/36. The league-aware forecast removes that bias."
  * The league-aware forecast does **not** remove the bias for Italy (LBA): its interval still excludes zero.
  * Every other league: "not distinguishable at this n".
* **Career year (E12).** In the league-aware model, a player whose source season beat his own history is forecast 1.39 EFF/36 lower (95% CI [-1.93, -0.75]), and the sign is negative in 6 of 6 walk-forward refits (range -1.52 to -1.08).
  * Licensed sentence: "Holding his domestic rate and history fixed, a player signed after a season above his own history is forecast 1.39 EFF/36 lower."
* **Exchange rate (descriptive).** A 16 in Spain's ACB is forecast the same as 18.7 in Germany's BBL for EuroCup (95% CI [17.7, 19.7]) and 19.1 for EuroLeague ([17.9, 20.4]). Full table below.
* **Weighted by playing time (E17.2) — a qualification, flagged to Amir.** When each forecast counts by its destination minutes, translation's gain over history shrinks to 0.098 EFF/36 (95% CI [-0.003, 0.198]), which **spans 0**. Unweighted it is 0.161 ([0.077, 0.246]), as submitted. The other two headline contrasts keep their reading when weighted.
* **How much error is avoidable (E17.3).** The E6 noise floor is 2.183 EFF/36, so history alone leaves 0.913 EFF/36 of avoidable error. The league-aware model removes 18.8% of it; translation on top of history removes 17.6%.
* **Penalty check (E17.1).** The head-to-head C_H (positive favours the league-aware model) and the recovered share S at each penalty: λ = 1: C_H +0.007 [-0.035, 0.049] (spans 0), S 1.04 [0.80, 1.46]; λ = 10: C_H +0.011 [-0.027, 0.049] (spans 0), S 1.07 [0.85, 1.48]; λ = 100: C_H -0.007 [-0.049, 0.035] (spans 0), S 0.96 [0.75, 1.36].
* **The 2% margin in plain units (E17.5).** 2% of the league-aware MAE is 0.058 EFF/36, which is 36.3% of the 0.161 gain translation gives over history. The six recipes' upper bounds are 0.009–0.025 EFF/36, i.e. 5.7%–15.5% of that gain.

## Specification

| Field | This note |
|---|---|
| **Unit** | one forecast = player × destination season, one continental destination (v10 rules) |
| **Population** | the 674 v10 anchor targets, destination seasons 2020–2025, pool A, recipe R1; E12 full fit and the exchange rate use the 1059 e9 training rows through 2025 |
| **Estimator** | E10 pairwise ordering accuracy (D1) and flip / right shares (D2) by pair type; E11 mean signed error (forecast − actual EFF/36) by source league; E12 the regression coefficient β_a on a = 1[source season above own history]; E17 completions of registered tables |
| **Null** | D1 difference = 0; right share = 0.5; signed error = 0; β_a = 0; E17 descriptive |
| **Filter** | v10 eligibility; targets fixed before scoring; no target dropped |
| **Key** | `player_name` × `season_dest`; pools = destination competition × destination season (12); clusters = destination club-season |
| **Uncertainty** | cluster bootstrap over destination club-seasons, 2000 draws, seed 0: within pool for E10 and E11 (E10 uses E7's exact draws), over all training club-seasons for E12 (e9's exact draws); two-way clustered (player, destination club-season) intervals for MAE contrasts; Holm across the 10 leagues for E11 |
| **E11 p-value** | two-sided bootstrap p = min(1, 2 (k + 1) / (B + 1)), k = draws on the smaller side of 0 |
| **Exchange rate** | x_L = 16 + (offset_ACB - offset_L) / (b_source + b_prior + b_ELxsource [EuroLeague only]); history = x_L, a = 0 |
